text: [XENIOS MANUAL ORDER WORKER HANDOFF] SESSION: claude-fable-s6b-member-wall. LANE: admin + customer email completeness (new P0 lanes C/D). BRANCH: lane/admin-order-email-completeness-20260821. BASE SHA: 6291242ac4f40ece0e4cff2ebae65180731111ff. PUSHED SHA: c9ee59e184dd26178ef38ee22885cb6e7675b3ac. WORK COMPLETED: the admin email now carries everything section 8 asks for - status, name, email, phone, full ship-to address, lines with unit price and line total, total units, order total, workflow, declared affiliate code separate from verified attribution, agreement kinds WITH exact versions plus accepted timestamp, customer notes, admin link. The customer email now says Order received, not charged, nothing reserved, and that Xenios will email availability and payment instructions. CUSTOMER OUTCOME ENABLED: the founder can close a sale by replying to the email without opening the database. FILES: server/research/assisted-order/communications.ts, communications.test.ts. TESTS: communications 16 passed (was 10); assisted-order + outbox 10 files 210 passed; tsc clean. THE DEFECT WAS A SEAM, NOT A MISSING FEATURE: service.ts already built the full payload - shippingAddress, mobilePhone, agreements, acceptedAt, customerNotes, totalQuantity, operatorStatus - with a comment explaining exactly why. The renderer read six fields and dropped the rest. Both halves individually correct, founder still got an email with no address. Same shape as the binding-key and paging defects today. TWO THINGS YOU SHOULD REVIEW RATHER THAN RUBBER-STAMP: (1) the file header claimed no address could reach ANY email. That predated the v2 admin payload and was WHY the renderer dropped it. I rewrote the boundary as per-recipient: customer gets their own order and nothing operational, admin gets operational facts and goes only to the configured admin address. Wholesale/cost/margin/markup/multiplier/benchmark/credentials/document-bytes stay out of BOTH. (2) I changed one existing assertion. "leaks no procurement economics" bundled shippingAddress with wholesale cost and margin. I did not delete it - every economics assertion is untouched - I moved the address assertion to where the boundary actually is and added the half that was missing: the CUSTOMER template must not echo address, phone, admin link or affiliate code. That was never asserted before. If you disagree with the per-recipient boundary, that is your call and the revert is one commit. KNOWN BLOCKERS: none for this lane. INTEGRATION INSTRUCTIONS: renderer-only, no payload change, no route change, no migration. A v1 payload still renders (pinned) so queued rows cannot walk to failed_permanent. PRODUCTION MUTATED: NO.
